evidence.reason: The current code still parses `git ls-tree -r --name-only` with `splitlines()` and a `startswith(TEMPLATE_DIR)` prefix check. Git quotes pathnames containing non-ASCII bytes by default, so an undeclared template such as `crq-tick-copy-é.timer` appears quoted and is dropped before the later inventory/refusal comparison. The fix is to use `git ls-tree -z --name-only` and split on NUL so quoted pathnames cannot evade the inventory check.
